title: Bearer credential: one-property twin (context)
summary: 10 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: the Authorization Bearer credential position replaced by an ETag header, context: the Authorization Bearer credential position replaced by an If-None-Match header, and context: the Authorization Bearer credential position replaced by an X-Build-Id header, and 7 more. Twin of "Bearer credential: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of bearer-token-client-yaml: context: the Authorization Bearer credential position replaced by an X-Build-Id header. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
